text.tspan: Film one swing down the line at the range. AIcoach
tells you what the fault is, where it comes from,
how sure it is, and the one drill and one mobility
exercise to work on next.

svg.text: Example result · synthetic demo data · Rory, 11 hcp, 7-iron, 120 fps

text.tspan: “It may feel like you stay
down, but at impact your hips
have moved toward the ball.”
Feel and reality often disagree in golf, so practising
on feel can groove the very fault you are fighting.
AIcoach puts the two side by side: what you probably
feel, and the key frame that shows what happened.

svg.text: Hips toward the ball: 7% of body height · threshold 4%

svg.text: Frees the hip turn your swing is missing.

text.tspan: Generic guidance, not medical advice — see a
physiotherapist if you feel pain.
Each drill is tied to one verified fault, each mobility exercise to its cause. A possible
fault or an unverified observation never gets a drill.

svg.text: Answers are based only on this analysis.

text.tspan: Why does it feel like I'm
staying down when I'm not?
Because your head and chest stay level,
so it feels steady. The movement happens
lower down: in your impact frame your
hips are 7% of your height closer to the
ball than at address. In the wall drill,
the moment your glute leaves the wall is
the moment you would stand up.

svg.text: How do I know the drill is working?
Bring your phone to the range.
Film one swing tonight. Read it one screen at a time.
A practice tool only, not for use during a competitive round. Mobility exercises are generic guidance, not medical advice.
